page.content:
Chariot arena and political theatre of the capital.

How Hippodrome of Constantinople connects

  • Location: Constantinople — The Hippodrome was the capital's public arena.
  • Event: Nika riots — The Nika riots erupted in and around the Hippodrome.

What is Hippodrome of Constantinople?

The Hippodrome sat beside the Great Palace and was where Blue and Green factions raced — and where the Nika riots of 532 exploded against Justinian.

Key threads lead to Constantinople and Nika riots.
